{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_data = data[(data['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
                      (data['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute the conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_converted = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(filtered_data)
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total

print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid_search: {n_total}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among them: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction as a float
conversion_rate"}
